blocks.text: Magnetic flux linkage electromagnetism ka aham tasawwur hai, khaas kar inductance aur electromagnetic induction ke mutale mein. Is se muraad coil se guzarne wale magnetic flux aur coil ke turns ki tadaad ka hasil-e-zarb hai. Yeh asal mein napta hai ke coil ke kai turns ki wajah se us se kitna magnetic flux jura (linked) hai, aur electrical circuits mein coils aur inductors ka kaam samajhne ka aham juz hai.

blocks.title: Magnetic flux linkage
blocks.text: Magnetic flux linkage = Phi = N phi_B ... (10.7), jahan phi_B raqbe A ke ek loop se magnetic flux aur N coil ke kul turns hain.

Magnetic flux linkage transformers, electric motors, generators aur inductors ke design aur kaam mein aham kirdar ada karta hai. Yeh tasawwur Faraday ke electromagnetic induction ke qanoon mein khaas taur par aham hai, jo is chapter mein aage aayega.

Jab aap credit ya ATM card Automated Teller Machine (ATM) mein dalte hain to card ki magnetic patti, jis mein resin binder se jure lakhon nanhe magnetic domains hote hain, machine parhti hai; patti par darj maloomat aap ko apne account tak rasai deti hai (For Your Information).

blocks.prompt: 10 turns aur 35 cm^2 raqbe wali coil 0.5 T ki amudi field mein hai. Is ka flux linkage kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Ek turn se flux: phi_B = BA = 0.5 x 35 x 10^-4 = 1.75 x 10^-3 Wb. Flux linkage = N phi_B = 10 x 1.75 x 10^-3 = 1.75 x 10^-2 Wb. Agar coil 1.0 s mein field se bahar nikali jaye to yeh linkage sifar ho jata hai aur ausat induced emf 1.75 x 10^-2 V hai (numerical 10.6).

items: Flux linkage = N phi_B (10.7): ek loop ka flux zarb turns ki tadaad; transformers, motors, generators, inductors aur Faraday ke qanoon ke liye bunyadi. Card ki patti nanhe magnetic domains mein maloomat rakhti hai.
